moduleSettings.disableImpactDesc: Operational effect before changing module availability.
moduleSettings.notConfiguredDesc: This module is reserved but does not have configurable settings yet.

modules.title: Modules

audit.title: Audit Log
audit.description: Append-only record of admin actions and auth events.

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.adminDesc: Full access to all modules, user management and workspace settings.
permissions.userDesc: Access to enabled productivity modules. Cannot access admin panel.
permissions.futureNote: Custom roles and fine-grained permissions are planned for a future release.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Workspace health, user activity and module status at a glance.

security.title: Security
security.description: Manage sessions, password policy and access controls.
security.sessionsDesc: Users currently signed in across all devices.
security.minLengthDesc: Fewest characters allowed in a password.
security.historyDesc: Block reuse of the last N passwords. 0 disables it.
security.ipAllowlistDesc: Restrict admin and auth requests to trusted networks.
security.ipAllowlistEnabledDesc: When enabled, only listed IPs or CIDRs are accepted.
security.allowedNetworksDesc: Enter one IP address or CIDR per line.
security.trustedProxiesDesc: Only these proxy IPs or CIDRs may supply Forwarded or X-Forwarded-For client addresses.
security.loginHistoryDesc: Review successful and failed sign-in attempts.

branding.title: Branding
branding.description: Customize the workspace name, logo and colors.
branding.workspaceNameDesc: Shown in the sidebar and browser title.
branding.primaryColorDesc: Used for buttons, links and active states.
branding.note: Branding customization will be available once the branding API is implemented.

oauth.title: OAuth Clients
oauth.description: Register and manage OAuth 2.1 / OIDC clients that can authenticate against this workspace.
oauth.emptyHint: Create a client for each app that needs to sign users in through Airbrew.
oauth.settingsDescription: Define how this app identifies itself, where tokens may be returned, and what access it can request.
oauth.name: Client name
oauth.nameDesc: Shown to admins and, when consent is required, to the user approving access.
oauth.clientTypeDesc: Public clients run on devices or browsers and cannot protect a secret. Confidential clients run on a trusted server and receive a one-time client secret.
oauth.clientTypeLockedDesc: Client type is fixed after creation because it changes how the token endpoint authenticates the app.
oauth.authMethodDesc: Controls how confidential clients send their secret to the token endpoint. Basic is the default and keeps secrets out of request bodies.
oauth.scopesDesc: Authorization requests outside the selected allowlist will be rejected. Add custom scopes only for modules that define their own permissions.

scopeDescriptions.openid: Required for OpenID Connect sign-in and ID token issuance.
scopeDescriptions.profile: Allows access to basic profile claims such as name and avatar.
scopeDescriptions.email: Allows access to email and email verification claims.
scopeDescriptions.auth: Allows authentication state and session-related APIs.

oauth.redirectUrisDesc: Exact callback URLs allowed after sign-in. OAuth compares these exactly, including scheme, host, path, and port.
oauth.logoutRedirectUrisDesc: Exact URLs the app may return to after RP-initiated logout. Leave empty if the app does not use OIDC logout.
oauth.firstPartyDesc: Marks an app you operate as part of this workspace. Later policy can use this to reduce friction for trusted internal apps.
oauth.requireConsentDesc: When enabled, users must approve the app and requested scopes before an authorization code is issued.
oauth.activeDesc: Inactive clients cannot start new OAuth flows. Existing token revocation will be handled by the token milestone.
oauth.secretCreated: Client secret created. It is shown once.
oauth.secretCreatedDesc: Store it now. Airbrew keeps only a hash and cannot display this secret again.
oauth.confirmRotateSecret: Rotate the secret for {{name}}? The previous secret will stop working immediately.
oauth.integrationSectionDesc: Use these values in the app or OAuth library that will sign in through Airbrew.
oauth.quickStartStep1: Configure the app with this issuer, client ID, redirect URI, and selected scopes.
oauth.quickStartStep2: Use Authorization Code flow with PKCE. Public clients use no client secret; confidential clients use the shown secret.
oauth.quickStartStep3: After sign-in, exchange the authorization code at the token endpoint, then validate the returned tokens.
oauth.identitySectionDesc: These settings decide what kind of app this is and how Airbrew recognizes it.
oauth.flowSectionDesc: These URLs are the hard boundary for where browser redirects may go.
oauth.accessSectionDesc: These controls define the scopes and approval behavior this client is allowed to use.

setup.tooWeak: Make the master password longer and harder to guess.

strength.hint: Use a long passphrase of at least 15 characters.
